tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Overall Experience for construction Garden, public recreation places / Operation and maintenance of Public Utility like Garden, public recreation places and others.The Bidder should have experience of undertaking at least 1 one projects assignment where they operated all the activities at one Government Institutions of State Central PSUs Semi Government certificate signed by not below the rank of Head of the Department where they operated all the above mentioned activities at one or more distinct locations in the last 5 years

1The Bidder should be a company incorporated in India under The Indian Companies Act, 1956/2013 and subsequent amendments thereto or a registered Partnership Firm under The Indian Partnership Act 1932 or Limited Liability Partnership Act 2008 or a Sole Proprietorship registered under the relevant Shops and Establishment Act with a registered office and operations in India.OR Bidder should upload the Class-3 and Above License issued by PWD and competent Authority

2Annual Turnover : The bidder should have minimum annual Turnover of INR 161.41 Lakhs for the last 5 financial years ending 31st March of the previous financial year i.e. FY 2021-22 to FY 2025-26. Credential of group companies or parent companies or subsidiary not allowed. refer tender document
3Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs. 24.21 Lakhs (Unconditional Credit lines/ letters of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc).

Every Bidder shall swear and upload an Affidavit accepting the above conditions and also stating that he / she has not been blacklisted by any Government Department / Autonomous Body / Corporation / Company / Local Body and that he / she is not involved in any litigation against any Government Department / Autonomous Body / Corporation / Company / Local Body.bidder should refere tender document
